heard: Apollo 11 astronaut Neil Armstrong flubbed his most famous line. Over 500 million people listened to his lunar broadcast live. He planned to say one small step for a man. In the broadcast, he dropped the word A. Without that word, man meant all of humanity. The speech accidentally compared mankind to mankind. Armstrong and NASA initially claimed radio static swallowed the syllable. After re-listening to recordings, Armstrong conceded he simply dropped it. official transcripts still place that elusive letter inside brackets. More than 500 million listeners heard that legendary slip.
